# Cranberries, Brain Mushroom & Bottle Gourd Places for cranberry sauce and brain bombs

![Cranberries, Brain Mushroom & Bottle Gourd Places for Cranberry Sauce and Brain Bombs](/uploads/748_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Cranberries

Cranberries are small, red berries that grow in the wet and swampy areas of Appalachia. The low cranberry bushes are particularly common in the Cranberry Bog, whose landscape also gives the plant its name. Despite the dangerous inhabitants of this region, the bright red berries are usually easy to see among the other vegetation.

Cranberries are particularly interesting for players because of their use in various recipes. They can be used to make, among other things, **Cranberry Casserole** and **Cranberry Sauce**, which grant a bonus to experience points received. **Cranberry sauce** in particular is a popular food for leveling and collecting XP with the **Herbivore** mutation.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-cranberrys-20260809131748-1.jpg)

## Brain fungus

Brain fungus is an unusual species of fungus that grows in dark and damp places throughout Appalachia. It gets its name from its striking, fleshy fruiting body, whose winding surface is reminiscent of a human brain. Brain fungi are commonly found in caves, tunnels, ruins, and other underground or poorly lit areas.

Collected brain mushrooms can be used in various dishes. **Brain Mushroom Soup** and **Brain Bombs** are particularly interesting because they increase **intelligence**. Since higher intelligence simultaneously increases the experience points received, these dishes are among the popular buffs when leveling - especially for players with the **herbivore** mutation.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-brain-fungus-20260809131930-1.jpg)

## Bottle gourd

The bottle gourd is a climbing crop with large green leaves and elongated, light green fruits. In contrast to many other plants in Appalachia, it appears comparatively ordinary and, even after the Great War, still closely resembles a classic cultivated plant. Wild specimens can only be found in a few places, but bottle gourds can also be found in your own C.A.M.P. grown and harvested regularly.

For EP buffs, the bottle gourd is particularly important as an ingredient for **cranberry sauce**. If you use this dish regularly, you can add some plants directly to your own C.A.M.P. grow and then mainly have to collect the required cranberries. For **herbivores**, a small supply of bottle gourds is particularly practical.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-gourd-20260809132722-1.jpg)

## Farming Tips

If you want to farm cranberries, mushrooms, and bottle gourds for cooking, don't forget to use the **Green Thumb** perk card under Perception to harvest twice the amount of plants and craft more dishes.

Also important when cooking: Perk card "**Super Duper**" at 3*. This means you have a **30% chance of getting twice the amount** when cooking.

After cooking, it's best to use the perk card "**A poem with salt**" to make your dishes last 90% longer, or a freezer.

In addition, the same spawn rules apply to plants as to loose objects such as: Scrap. So before your farming round, make sure you have emptied your **loot list** so that you can find enough plants everywhere. See article.
